## Talk

### Randomized Quasi-Monte Carlo: Theory and Practice

Fred J. Hickernell  
Illinois Institute of Technology

---

## Slides

---

## Abstract

Randomized quasi-Monte Carlo (RQMC) methods combine the variance reduction
properties of quasi-Monte Carlo with the statistical error estimation
capabilities of Monte Carlo methods.

These techniques have become an important tool for high-dimensional numerical
integration and uncertainty quantification.

This talk discusses theoretical foundations and practical implementation of
RQMC methods together with examples from recent applications.
